tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exception for development. This is consistent with the separately recorded rule that https is used everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with one paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development included, with no exception for development. It also notes that this matches the separate rule to use https everywhere.

The verification decision is Muninn record #24 ("verification on all builds"). It replaced an earlier record saying verification was off in dev builds, so I left the retired value out. Record #27 ("https everywhere, no exceptions") is the source for the https line.

One thing you may want to check: Muninn's heartbeat is red, with 20 hook runs started and never finished. The records I used came back clean, but a hook exceeding its timeout may mean the memory isn't being updated reliably. The details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
